failures.quote: Guess kariye kuch mahino baad bandar kaisa bartaav karenge
failures.why: After Tara showed she did not understand why marked paths matter, the teacher dropped the topic entirely and jumped to monkeys, leaving the skill unresolved.

judged2.verdict: Madam made Tara repeat the same answers too many times and never cleared up why feeding monkeys chips is bad, so Tara got bored and the concepts didn’t stick.
